resumeText:
Pooja Iyer | Bengaluru | pooja.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Murex Technical Consultant, Cauvery Capital Technologies, Bengaluru (2020 - present)
- Built MxML Exchange workflows to import trades from upstream booking systems into Murex MX.3.
- Wrote XSLT transformations to map upstream trade messages into the Murex format.
- Supported the trade lifecycle for interest rate swaps and FX forwards from capture to settlement.
- Delivered interface changes for a private sector bank's treasury operations.
- Wrote SQL queries on Oracle to reconcile datamart extracts with front-office positions.
- Automated end-of-day checks with Unix shell scripts on Linux servers.
- Gathered requirements from the treasury desk and wrote functional specifications for new interfaces.

SKILLS
Murex MX.3, MxML, Datamart, Oracle SQL, Unix, XSLT

EDUCATION
BE Information Science, RV College of Engineering, 2020
